description: The canonical, platform-neutral color-role contract for HUG. The provisional theme roots establish a starting direction; no color values are approved until they pass visual and accessibility review.

appearancePreference.description: A person may follow the device appearance or explicitly choose either theme. This is a cross-platform preference contract, not a web-only Settings implementation.

rules.componentsConsume: semantic roles or documented component roles, never reference palette values
rules.themeResolution: every semantic role maps in both themes
rules.feedback: feedback states require a non-color cue where the distinction matters
rules.surfaceContext: a component resolves its treatment relative to its containing surface

webAdapter.propertyNameRule: Join semantic token path segments with hyphens after the prefix; retain numeric segments and explicit state segments.
webAdapter.implementationRule: Emit no CSS custom properties until approved values exist. When values are introduced, populate the light map at :root, override explicit light and dark preferences with the theme attribute, and use the system-dark media query only when no explicit preference is set.

referenceFamilies.name: color.palette.purple.*
referenceFamilies.description: The only v1 general-purpose reference family. Exact steps and values are deferred.

tokens.name: surface.0
tokens.description: Base surface in the relational surface ladder.

tokens.name: surface.1
tokens.description: First raised or nested surface relationship.

tokens.name: surface.2
tokens.description: Second raised or nested surface relationship.

tokens.name: content.primary
tokens.description: Default high-emphasis text and icon content.

tokens.name: content.disabled
tokens.description: Unavailable content; never a feedback signal.

tokens.name: content.inverse
tokens.description: Content placed on an inverse or strong action surface.

tokens.name: separator.default
tokens.description: Cross-cutting structural divider between content regions.

tokens.name: action.primary.{default,hover,disabled,selected}
tokens.description: Highest-emphasis general action state family. Selected is conditional on a persistent control need.

tokens.name: action.secondary.{default,hover,disabled,selected}
tokens.description: Supporting general action state family. Selected is conditional on a persistent control need.

tokens.name: action.quiet.{default,hover,disabled,selected}
tokens.description: Low-emphasis actions and link coloration. Selected is conditional on a persistent control need.

tokens.name: focus.ring
tokens.description: Theme-aware focus indicator that remains visible across surfaces and controls.

tokens.name: selection.background
tokens.description: Background for broad UI or text selection.

tokens.name: selection.content
tokens.description: Content color on a selection background.

tokens.name: feedback.{success,warning,danger,info}.{content,surface,border}
tokens.description: Status treatments; field validation may map to success or danger without duplicating palettes.

tokens.name: backdrop.overlay
tokens.description: Theme-aware backdrop behind drawers, dialogs, and similar overlays.

deferred: new reference values, introduced only when an interface need demonstrates their role
semantic-to-reference aliases for light and dark beyond the approved action anchors
CSS custom-property declarations populated with approved values
